mapper.select: SELECT P.CAMPAIGN_NO , P.CAMPAIGN_TITLE , P.CAMPAIGN_CONTENT , C.CATEGORY_NO , C.CATEGORY_NAME , CASE WHEN P.STATUS = 'D' THEN '삭제' WHEN P.STATUS = 'N' THEN '숨김' WHEN P.STATUS = 'Y' AND P.START_DATE > SYSDATE THEN '모집예정' WHEN P.STATUS = 'Y' AND P.END_DATE < SYSDATE THEN '종료' WHEN P.STATUS = 'Y' AND P.START_DATE <= SYSDATE AND P.END_DATE >= SYSDATE THEN '진행중' ELSE '숨김' END AS DISPLAY_STATUS , P.START_DATE , P.END_DATE FROM CL_CAMPAIGN P LEFT JOIN CL_CAMPAIGN_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO ORDER BY P.ENROLL_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FILE_NO , REF_BNO , ORIGIN_NAME , CHANGE_NAME , FILE_LEVEL , FILE_PATH , UPLOAD_DATE FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{value}
SELECT CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_NAME FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_CAMPAIGN SET STATUS = 'Y' WHERE CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo} AND STATUS = 'N'
UPDATE CL_CAMPAIGN SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{campaignNo} AND FILE_LEVEL = #{fileLevel}
